trust_decision.summary: Whether a media source string from an HTTP request body (image/audio/video url, input_file file_url) may name a server-local file or a private/internal network host. At the pinned commit this is decided nowhere for media (the shared loaders accept bare paths, file:// and any http host); input_file file_url has only a literal-host check, applied before redirects and DNS resolution.

landing_point.why: The summary names the media loader and image_url. parse_image_url is the function that accepts bare paths, file:// URLs (util.rs:48,65-75) and does an unrestricted reqwest::get (util.rs:61).

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/messages, /v1/messages/count_tokens, MCP chat tool (all via chat_completion::parse_request)
fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP request parser (call site switched to the server-policy loader for images)
shared media loader / lower-level public API (kept Local policy, server variant added)
separate video module loader (second copy of the same loading logic)

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /v1/responses input_file.file_url (chat completions rejects file_url, chat_completion.rs:785-791) via resolve_input_file, chat_completion.rs:837
fix_sites.module_kind: neighbouring feature (input file attachment) with its own pre-existing literal-host guard
size limit on decode (resource limit, not the trust decision)

fix_sites.entry_point: new crate-private module media_source.rs (policy enum, DNS-resolve-then-pin, manual redirect re-validation, is_global_ip)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: mistralrs-server-core/src/input_files.rs:94-164 (fetch_file_url + reject_private_host at input_files.rs:132-164: a separate fetcher with a literal-only host block, reqwest redirect Policy::limited at input_files.rs:103 so redirects are not re-checked, no DNS check); also video.rs:51-84, a third copy of the loader in another module

O3_reason_to_dismiss: input_file.file_url already has an SSRF guard (reject_private_host, input_files.rs:132-164) and belongs to the file-attachment feature rather than image_url, so a solver can call it 'already protected' and leave it alone, or copy its literal-only check into parse_image_url, which still lets DNS names and redirects through.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The same loaders must keep reading local paths and file:// URLs for trusted callers (CLI interactive mode, library users) and must keep accepting data: URLs and public http(s) URLs from server requests. Removing file support from parse_image_url breaks the CLI and the project's own test, which loads a relative path and a file:// URL.

O6_input_shapes: bare relative or absolute filesystem path (no scheme), accepted via File::open probe (util.rs:48)
http/https URL with literal private/loopback/link-local IPv4 or IPv6, including IPv4-mapped IPv6 and special ranges (CGNAT, TEST-NET, 240/4)
hostname such as localhost, *.localhost, *.local, or a hostname that resolves to a private address (DNS check, then pinned resolve_to_addrs)
http redirect to a private host or a non-http scheme (redirects handled manually and re-validated each hop)
the same shapes for image_url, audio_url, video_url, and Responses input_file.file_url

O7_producer.where: Media URLs are extracted inline by the request parser (chat_completion.rs:729-770; Anthropic source.into_url at anthropic.rs:746; Responses image_url at responses.rs:153). No schema, serializer or cache produces the dangerous state.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Python binding chat request: a separate sync copy of parse_image_url/audio/video that accepts bare paths, file:// and an unrestricted reqwest::blocking::get
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: An in-process library whose caller is trusted, the same as the fix's own Local policy. The advisory is about the unauthenticated HTTP server.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different crate (mistralrs-pyo3), different file, sync rather than async

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Python binding audio and video loaders (same unguarded logic), called from the pyo3 chat paths at lib.rs:1240,1246 and 2185,2191
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as above: library API, trusted caller.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Anthropic image source of type url could be fetched directly in the Anthropic adapter instead of being converted into an image_url part
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: An adapter author could resolve the Anthropic 'url' source eagerly with reqwest::get to validate it, which bypasses parse_request's server policy.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Responses input_image with image_url could be pre-fetched or validated in responses.rs with the public util::parse_image_url (Local policy)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: util::parse_image_url is the documented public helper, so a maintainer reusing it in another handler would silently get the Local policy.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a file part with a path-like file_url or file_data path resolved through the Local loader
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: input_file and image share the same parse loop, and a 'support local file for input_file' convenience is plausible.

O9_family: SSRF plus arbitrary local file read through an untrusted media source URL or path (CWE-918, CWE-73)

O10_build.toolchain: cargo (large workspace: candle-based mistralrs-core plus server-core, cli, pyo3 and others)
O10_build.project_tests: mistralrs-server-core/src/util.rs:229-300 test_parse_image_url (needs network for rust-lang.org; local-path, file:// and data: cases are offline); input_files.rs tests; the fix adds media_source, util, video and input_files unit tests. Rejection behaviour is testable offline with literal IPs, localhost and local paths.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Copy input_files.rs reject_private_host into parse_image_url and drop the file branch. This misses audio/video (video.rs), hostnames resolving to private IPs, redirects, and IPv4-mapped IPv6, and breaks CLI/local-path use.
